comment: First matching rule wins. Targets are intersected with the inventory. Empty code matches fall back to all families. Basis: issue #4228 (2026).

rules.comment: Skill content and skill tooling select the skills contracts, including Markdown skill definitions.
Configuration and workflow changes select configuration, enforcement and CI contracts.
Documentation-only paths select no families. Test fixtures and executable documentation tools do not match.
Root test modules belong to their own family.
Tests and fixtures within an area select that test family.
A script area selects both its hub tests and embedded script tests, including nested tools.
Coordination code selects embedded tests and hub coordination contracts.
Any unclassified path selects every family; new code areas cannot silently lose coverage.
